h: Kuda Bank to lay off about 40 staff in second round of cuts this year
p: Digital bank Kuda is reportedly cutting about 40 jobs across seven countries, around 7.5% of its workforce, as it aims for profitability by 2027.
body: Nigerian digital bank Kuda is reportedly preparing to lay off about 40 employees across seven countries, its second round of job cuts in 2026.
The restructuring will affect around 7.5% of the bank's workforce in Nigeria, the United Kingdom, South Africa, Canada, Tanzania, Uganda and Ghana.
The company is said to be cutting costs as it works to become profitable by 2027. Its chief executive is reported to have explained the decision to staff.
The move has raised fresh concerns about job security in Nigeria's fintech industry.
more: Kuda wants to be profitable by 2027.
